title: Sagiwall PVC exterior cladding
jurisdiction: Canada — national CCMC product evaluation; comparative attachment only, not a Calgary/Edmonton or Alberta project application

facts.text: The report’s CAN/ULC-S134 table records Pass for the requirement that flames not spread more than 5 m above the opening and Pass for heat flux no more than 35 kW/m² at 3.5 m above the opening.
The NBC 2015 opinion covers the evaluated Sagiwall exterior cladding for buildings of combustible construction and classifies Article 9.27.12 Vinyl Siding as Alternative.
The fire test and wind-test backup-wall conditions are described in the report.
facts.locator: CCMC 14043-R PDF, p. 6, Table 3 notes and test description

limitations: CAN/ULC-S134 result applies to the described tested wall assembly, not any assembly using the product.
No building-specific drawings or project facts are attached.
